name: The Ritz-Carlton Rancho Mirage
insider_take: Desert luxury meets Hollywood glamour at this stunning Coachella Valley oasis, where Frank Sinatra once owned a home just minutes away.
whats_special: This desert sanctuary sits on 24 acres with breathtaking Santa Rosa Mountain views and features the largest spa in the Coachella Valley. The property's signature restaurant, STATE Fare Bar & Kitchen, showcases California cuisine with ingredients from their on-site herb garden. The resort also boasts the area's only Ritz-Carlton Club Level experience in the desert.
pro_tip: Book a mountain-view suite on the upper floors for spectacular sunrise views over the San Jacinto Mountains – the golden hour light is absolutely magical for photos.
dont_miss: The nearby Indian Canyons offer world-class hiking through ancient palm oases, and you're just 20 minutes from the iconic mid-century modern architecture of Palm Springs. During festival season, Coachella and Stagecoach venues are a short drive away, making this the perfect luxury basecamp.
pros: Stunning desert mountain views and luxurious spa facilities
Championship golf course and premium dining experiences
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Prime Coachella Valley location near Palm Springs attractions
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Desert location may be warm during summer months
